$comment: Structured mirror of The Anchor's Single Source of Truth. The canonical, human-edited source is docs/SSOT.md. If this JSON and the Markdown disagree, the Markdown wins and this file should be reconciled. AI agents, copywriters, and developers should read docs/SSOT.md before writing customer-facing content. Use this JSON for stable programmatic facts only; volatile data such as opening hours, kitchen hours, drinks stock, food and drink prices, event dates, current review counts, and live ranks must come from the management API, POS, or approved live source.

identity.name: The Anchor
identity.naming_rule: Use 'The Anchor' as the default customer-facing name. Use 'The Anchor Pub' only where SEO value warrants it (page titles, alt text, schema name fields). Never use 'The Anchor Pub' as the conversational default. See docs/SSOT.md section 1.
identity.type: Independent British village pub and restaurant
identity.detailed_heritage: A village pub since 1751, with evidence of an Anchor Inn on the site by at least 1730. The present building appears to be mid-Victorian, standing on the site of the earlier pub. Stood here before Heathrow existed; Heathrow grew from a grass airstrip in the 1940s.
identity.founding_year_note: RESOLVED 2026-03-22: Canonical year is 1751. Claims.json (1866), blog posts (1869), and footer ('since the 1800s') are all incorrect and should be updated.

Live sports on TV (terrestrial only: BBC/ITV/Channel 4)

beer_garden.flight_path: Directly under Heathrow's southern runway approach path

options.notes: Carved fresh, served with a sage and onion stuffing ball.

options.name: Beef & Ale Pie
options.notes: Slow-cooked British beef in ale gravy under golden short-crust pastry. NO Yorkshire pudding with the pies.

options.name: Chicken & Wild Mushroom Pie
options.notes: Tender chicken and wild mushrooms in creamy sauce under golden short-crust pastry. NO Yorkshire pudding with the pies.

options.name: Beetroot & Butternut Squash Wellington
options.notes: Fully vegan. Default gravy is the regular vegan gravy. Free upgrade to the signature gravy on request, that contains meat stock, so the upgrade makes the dish non-vegan. Use 'vegan' (never 'vegetarian') in customer copy.

options.name: Kids Roast
options.notes: Smaller, child-sized plate. Choice of roast pork, roast turkey or beetroot & butternut squash wellington. Yorkshire pudding only with pork or turkey.

sunday_roast.RETIRED_OPTIONS: As of 2026-04-29 the following are RETIRED. Do NOT list: Roasted Chicken (adult), Slow-Cooked Lamb Shank, Crispy Pork Belly, Cauliflower Cheese side. Lamb in particular is no longer offered anywhere.
sunday_roast.accompaniments: Triple-cooked, herb-and-garlic crusted roast potatoes (we do NOT use beef dripping); seasonal vegetables; Yorkshire pudding with the three sliced roasts and the kids roast (NOT with the pies); our signature gravy, a secret recipe refined ourselves over the years. Regular gravy IS vegan and is the default for the wellington.

gravy_rules.signature_gravy: Default for all meat dishes. Secret recipe, made from scratch. Contains meat stock, NOT vegan.
gravy_rules.regular_gravy: Default for the wellington. Fully vegan. Available on request with any dish.
gravy_rules.wellington_upgrade: Wellington customers can upgrade for free to the signature gravy on request, note the upgrade makes the dish non-vegan.

nearby_nature.name: Staines Moor Nature Reserve
nearby_nature.description: Ancient SSSI grassland, never ploughed in 1,000+ years, with over 200 bird species.

nearby_nature.name: River Colne Footpath
nearby_nature.description: Bankside path south through open wetland countryside towards Staines Moor.

nearby_nature.name: King George VI Reservoir Path
nearby_nature.description: Fenced embankment causeway between two vast reservoirs; outstanding winter wildfowl.

nearby_nature.name: Staines Reservoir Causeway Path
nearby_nature.description: High-level path across twin Staines Reservoirs (built 1902); superb birdwatching.

nearby_nature.name: Lammas Recreation Ground & Church Lammas Lakes
nearby_nature.description: Restored gravel-pit lakes in Staines with wheelchair-accessible paths, cafe, and toilets.

nearby_nature.name: Colne Valley Trail / Colne Valley Way
nearby_nature.description: Long-distance greenway from Thames at Staines to Rickmansworth; passes through Stanwell Moor.

nearby_nature.name: Stanwell Village Walk (Surrey County Council)
nearby_nature.description: Official easy walk with 1.4-mile and 2.7-mile options; longer route reaches Staines Reservoir.

nearby_nature.name: Stanwell and Staines Moor Circular
nearby_nature.description: Signposted moderate circular walk (~2.5 hrs) past reservoirs, Staines Moor, and River Colne.

nearby_nature.name: Bedfont Lakes Country Park
nearby_nature.description: 73-hectare Local Nature Reserve with four lakes, wildflower meadows, woodland trails, and dog exercise area.

nearby_nature.name: Wraysbury Reservoir & Lakes
nearby_nature.description: Internationally important SSSI wetland; superb wildfowl including smew, goldeneye, and kingfisher.

nearby_nature.name: Wraysbury and Hythe End Gravel Pits
nearby_nature.description: 117-hectare SSSI of former gravel workings with open water, fen, wet woodland, and scrub.

nearby_nature.name: Runnymede & Ankerwycke (National Trust)
nearby_nature.description: Historic Thames-side meadows where Magna Carta was sealed; ancient Ankerwycke Yew; free access.

community_context.dining_room_history: Original conservatory built in 1995 for George and Alex Best's wedding reception. Replaced with new dining room extension, renovation started April 2024, ready for Euro 2024 (14 June). Features French doors to garden.
